Marta (AE): Priyanka from AtlasPay needs a short POC checklist before legal signs off. Top concerns: SAML session length, SCIM delta imports, RBAC for branch admins, domain claim automation (CNAME), and a 2-week Dedicated pilot cost.

Ibrahim (Sales Eng): Short answers: SP & IdP flows supported, NameID options (email/persistent), we support SignedAssertion and SignedResponse. For SCIM we support PATCH, bulk CSV -> batched PATCH.

Priyanka (Customer): Our Okta uses nested groups. We need team-admins who can invite users but not touch billing. Can you map nested groups to scoped roles?

Leo (Platform PM): Yes. We map groups to roles at the tenant or namespace level. Example mapping doc will show okta:team-x -> tenant-admin:team-x without billing perms.

Sofia (Security): Requirements from risk: BYOK KMS, audit logs for SCIM with actor identity, cert rotation cadence. We support AWS KMS and Vault via connector; audit logs exportable to S3 or SIEM; rotation policy configurable.

Riley (SRE): SCIM rate limits default: 120/min per tenant. We include Retry-After on 429 and exponential backoff. For big imports we can temporarily raise limits with ops coordination.

Ibrahim (Sales Eng): Sample SCIM PATCH snippet we'll attach to the doc for their IdP team.

Priyanka (Customer): For domain verification we prefer CNAME and an API recheck trigger so our CI can poll. Also any wildcard support?

Riley (SRE): We accept CNAME or TXT. We offer POST /domains/{domain}/verify to trigger checks. Wildcards require explicit CNAME per wildcard; we don't accept a single umbrella claim. Polling job runs ~60s.

Leo (Platform PM): Pricing: Hosted credits recommended for fast POC. Dedicated short pilot needs legal addendum; baseline 4-GPU capacity for production-like tests. I'll draft a cost delta and PS hours.

Marta (AE): Action items by Thu EOD: Ibrahim -> config snippets; Sofia -> security answers; Leo -> pricing + Dedicated pilot addendum; Riley -> SCIM ops note + verify API path. Priyanka: please share Okta metadata and risk spreadsheet.
